law_name: Law of 30 July 2018 on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data
key_requirements: GDPR applies: lawful basis, data subject rights, breach notification
deceased_data: No specific Belgian rules on deceased persons' data; GDPR covers living persons only
research_exemption: Title 4 regime for archiving, scientific/historical research and statistics: derogations from data subject rights with safeguards (pseudonymisation, DPO art. 190, records arts. 191-192, info art. 193)
genetic_data: Special category (art. 9 GDPR); controller must keep list of categories of persons with access to genetic/biometric/health data and their roles, given to DPA on request
